content.heading: EMPOWERING BUSINESSES THROUGH INNOVATIVE TECHNOLOGY SOLUTIONS
content.tagline: Leading enterprise hardware distribution, turnkey deployment, and digital engineering across KSA, Bahrain, and USA.

content.description: DEYSLA IT Solutions is a premier technology provider operating across Saudi Arabia, the Kingdom of Bahrain, and the United States. We specialize in supply, deployment, and lifecycle maintenance of mission-critical IT infrastructure.

services.title: Cyber Security
services.shortDescription: Proactive cybersecurity solutions that protect systems, data, users, and business operations.
services.overview: In an era of sophisticated digital threats, DEYSLA provides comprehensive cyber protection tailored to corporate and governmental infrastructure. From next-generation firewall deployments to managed endpoint response (EDR), we establish zero-trust perimeter defense and continuous security hygiene.
services.imageAlt: DEYSLA Cyber Security Operations & Zero-Trust Threat Defense
deliverables: Real-Time Endpoint Isolation & Malware Defense Protocols

process.title: Security Assessment
process.description: Audit current network perimeters, open attack surfaces, and user privileges.

process.title: Architecture Design
process.description: Engineer segmented zero-trust zones, firewall policies, and encrypted tunnels.

process.title: Deployment & Hardening
process.description: Deploy hardware appliances, install EDR agents, and enforce access controls.

process.title: Continuous Monitoring
process.description: Maintain proactive telemetry, firmware updates, and 24/7 incident alerting.

services.title: Security Systems
services.shortDescription: Enterprise CCTV surveillance, biometric access control, and integrated physical facility protection.
services.overview: DEYSLA engineers robust physical security ecosystems designed to safeguard industrial plants, corporate headquarters, and commercial centers. We combine high-resolution IP optical surveillance with intelligent video analytics, turnstiles, and multi-factor biometric authentication.

reviews.quote: DEYSLA delivered our entire campus structured cabling and server rack migration ahead of schedule. Their technical precision, certified OTDR testing documentation, and local SLA support are second to none in the Eastern Province.
The biometric turnstiles and AI IP surveillance system deployed by DEYSLA gave us seamless central control over access rights and parking gates across four commercial buildings.
DEYSLA's industrial networking and DIN-rail enclosure deployment maintained uninterrupted operations in harsh factory environments. Zero packet loss across critical PLC automation loops.
Migrating 800+ IP telephony extensions and multi-branch network routing with DEYSLA was frictionless. Their engineers provided continuous on-site staging and 24/7 handover support.

faqs.question_en: What core enterprise technology solutions does DEYSLA provide?
faqs.question_ar: ما هي حلول التكنولوجيا المؤسسية الأساسية التي تقدمها ديسلا؟
faqs.answer_en: DEYSLA delivers turnkey enterprise IT infrastructure, structured cabling (Cat6A & Fiber), data center staging, cybersecurity & next-gen firewalls, CCTV IP surveillance, biometric speed gates, industrial automation networking, and business telephony.
faqs.answer_ar: تقدم ديسلا بنية تحتية متكاملة لتقنية المعلومات، التمديدات الهيكلية، تجهيز مراكز البيانات، الأمن السيبراني، المراقبة بالكاميرات، البوابات الأمنية، وشبكات الأتمتة الصناعية.

faqs.question_en: Are your hardware products and brand alliances genuine OEM components?
faqs.question_ar: هل منتجات الأجهزة والماركات الشريكة أصلية ومعتمدة؟
faqs.answer_en: Yes. All hardware supplied by DEYSLA is 100% genuine OEM certified equipment sourced directly through authorized regional and global distribution channels, complete with manufacturer warranty and serial verification.
faqs.answer_ar: نعم. جميع الأجهزة الموردة من ديسلا أصلية ومعتمدة 100% من المصنعين مباشرة مع ضمان رسمي وتوثيق بالأرقام التسلسلية.

faqs.question_en: Where are your regional support offices located?
faqs.question_ar: أين تقع مكاتب الدعم الإقليمية الخاصة بكم؟
faqs.answer_en: DEYSLA operates certified regional facilities in Al Khalidiya, Dammam (Kingdom of Saudi Arabia), BIW Business Park, Al Hidd (Bahrain), and Charleston, West Virginia (United States).
faqs.answer_ar: تعمل مكاتب ديسلا الإقليمية في الخالدية بالدمام (المملكة العربية السعودية)، مجمع البحرين الاستثماري (البحرين)، وتشارلستون في فرجينيا الغربية (الولايات المتحدة).

faqs.question_en: How can I request a formal Quotation (RFQ) for an infrastructure project?
faqs.question_ar: كيف يمكنني طلب عرض أسعار رسمي لمشروع بنية تحتية؟
faqs.answer_en: You can build your Bill of Quantities (BOQ) directly on our website via the commercial catalog and submit an RFQ, or reach our regional engineering desk at enquiry-sa@deysla.com or +966-544553670.
faqs.answer_ar: يمكنك إعداد قائمة الكميات الخاصة بك مباشرة عبر موقعنا وتقديم طلب عرض أسعار أو التواصل مع مكتبنا الهندسي عبر enquiry-sa@deysla.com.
